title: Typed compiler economics and semantic parity
objective: Select the simplest typed EvaluationOracle implementation that preserves canonical plugin semantics and materially improves end-to-end solve economics after compile cost is charged.
hypothesis: A typed nested kernel will remove dynamic graph overhead, and runtime straight-line generation will be worthwhile only for graphs whose measured evaluation count amortizes its additional compile latency.

included: domain, guard, branch and target observations
excluded: legacy runtime imports or legacy outputs as truth

literature.claim: Official Julia guidance identifies type stability, function barriers and preallocation as central performance mechanisms.
literature.assumptions: The compiler sees stable concrete call paths and reusable buffers.
literature.break_conditions: Opaque dynamic dispatch or generated-method code-size explosion dominates runtime.

literature.claim: RuntimeGeneratedFunctions constructs immediately callable functions without ordinary world-age errors.
literature.assumptions: Generated expressions use a controlled module context and frozen plugin references.
literature.break_conditions: Arbitrary input code, closure conversion, plugin mutation or excessive compile latency.

literature.claim: The nonlinear function interface accepts optional Jacobian, JVP, VJP, sparsity and color metadata.
literature.assumptions: Function shape and optional capabilities remain stable for a compiled problem.
literature.break_conditions: A branch changes structure without producing a distinct compiled chart.

controls.description: Clear allocation-tolerant reference graph interpreter with explicit node and status semantics.
Handwritten Julia kernels for analytic synthetic families, used only as a performance floor.
differences_from_baseline: Never used as the semantic oracle

candidates.description: Pre-resolved typed topological instruction plan without runtime source generation.
Straight-line nested scalar and batch kernels built with RuntimeGeneratedFunctions.
differences_from_baseline: Plugin calls resolved to allowlisted global references

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure CSE, graph depth and instruction-count economics independently of geometry names.
Exercise Point, Line, Circle, distance and projection compositions at increasing depth.
Check 0/1/2-candidate status, selector margin and discriminant behavior.
Preserve loop, control-flow and transcendental black-box plugin calls.

real_problem_policy: Translated development cases may measure timing only after independent Gold audit; no retired output or artifact is accepted as truth.

execution_order: Run semantic differential tests before any timing result is inspected
Compare warm scalar and batch kernels
Measure first compile and first call separately
design.pairing: All variants evaluate identical graph instances, coordinates, numeric types and local-solve starts.
design.freeze_rule: Freeze code-generation thresholds before the family-disjoint locked timing run.
design.locked_validation_rule: A semantic mismatch burns the run and blocks timing-based promotion until corrected and rerun on a new locked seed set.
notes: At least 10000 valid, 10000 invalid/domain and 2000 selector-boundary evaluations are required.
At least 2000 Dual directional checks and 1000 BigFloat spot checks are required.

batch_sizes.rationale: Separates local scalar use from discovery screening throughput.
batch_sizes.freeze_rule: Choose once on development timing before locked validation.

float_comparison_ulps_factor.rationale: Allows bounded reassociation error while still detecting changed semantics.
float_comparison_ulps_factor.freeze_rule: May only be changed from a forward-error analysis, never to excuse a mismatch.

rgf_break_even_evaluations.rationale: Prevents runtime generation from slowing ordinary multistart solves.

rgf_compile_p95_seconds.rationale: Bounds one-problem latency before search begins.
rgf_compile_p95_seconds.freeze_rule: No upward tuning after locked results.

budgets.accounting: Charge graph lowering, JIT first call, calibration, evaluation, local solve and canonical validation separately and end-to-end.

seeds.generation: Generator seeds and point sets are produced before timing and stored with checksums in the run artifacts.

primary.definition: Cold compile through canonical validation for 32 paired local starts.

secondary.definition: Steady-state canonical evaluations per second by graph stratum.
Compile cost divided by saved per-evaluation time.
Heap allocations after reusable buffers and derivative preparations exist.

safety.definition: Status, branch, guard, target or residual mismatches outside declared ambiguity.
Float64 constants or values contaminating Dual or BigFloat execution.

criteria: Semantic mismatch and numeric-type contamination counts are zero.
The promoted typed compiler is at least 10x faster than R0 at the warm median and 2x at p90.
Evaluator-heavy 32-start end-to-end time improves by at least 20 percent.
Median compiled warm time is no more than 2x the handwritten lower-bound kernel on primary geometry families.
C2 is selected over C1 only if it improves end-to-end time by 20 percent or has median break-even at most 256 evaluations.
Any unresolved semantic, branch, guard or numeric-type mismatch occurs.
The hot path requires eval or invokelatest.
C2 compile p95 exceeds 2 seconds and break-even exceeds 1024 evaluations without end-to-end gain.
C2 remains within 5 percent of C1, in which case C2 is removed and C1 is retained.
Generated kernels cannot execute the opaque type-generic plugin family.

safety_invariants: ReferenceGraphInterpreter remains the only semantic reference.
All candidate endpoints are re-evaluated through canonical semantics.
JSON never supplies executable source code.
Compiler selection never depends on a case ID, primitive name or known answer.
